transcript.text: Welcome back. Last time you got through the introduction of the scaling-laws paper. How much time do you have today?

Ten is fine. That's one section done properly instead of three skimmed, so we'll take the results section and leave the discussion for next time. Read the three curves in Figure 1 and tell me what they have in common.
Loss follows a power law in compute, data, and parameters, and the exponents tell you where extra budget is best spent.

That's the claim, and you got the part most people miss: the exponents are what make it actionable rather than just a nice-looking line. Next session we'll take the discussion and you can push on how far it generalises.
